summary: A pre-indexed code knowledge graph that auto-syncs on code changes, designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, CoPilot, and Hermes Agent. It provides a local, token-efficient way to understand codebases.
usecases: Analyze code structure without full repository cloning
Perform automated refactoring or impact analysis
ideas: Create a VS Code extension for real-time code understanding
Build a CLI tool to query code patterns
Develop a web dashboard to visualize code dependency graphs
